subject: Signal and System
questionText:
The periodic signal x(t) is real and Ck are it’s
exponential Fourier series coefficient. If value of C1 =
1 + 3j, C2 = 0.5 + 0.5 j then the value of C–1 and C–2
will be ___________ and ________.
(a)
1 – 3j, 0.5 + 0.5j
(b) 1 + 3j, 0.5 + 0.5j
(c)
1 – 3j, 0.5 – 0.5j
(d) 1 + 3j, 0.5 – 0.5j
explanation: Practice Question from Signal and System DPP-14 (CTFS and Its Properties).
